com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth store:prices:write consent. Requires separate store:prices:write and current EDIT_LISTINGS. The connected account must own an approved store.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Persists a draft plan; listing prices and automation are unchanged.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Unavailable listings, holds, sales, price bounds or unusable strategy guidance prevent proposals. Changed versions require fresh preparation and human review.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: No live price changes, recurring pricing, inventory or publishing. Preparation cannot approve its own plan.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Prepare a frozen card price plan for authenticated human approval in SuperCatch.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns the canonical connection-bound exact price plan, approval URL, nine-minute expiry and bounded change pages. Signed implementation tokens remain private. Only eligible changes on this selected page are included; inspect the read-only preview for skipped rows and more pages.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Compatibility name for page-based strategy or exact listingId/price proposals. Prefer supercatch_prepare_price_changes with explicit listing versions. Never combine updates and strategy filters.

cardType.description: Review RAW, graded/authenticated, or all active in-stock card copies in the connected store.

cursor.description: Continue with nextCursor from the previous page, keeping the same selection.

direction.description: Filter one-time price changes. Ongoing repricing requires ANY; publishing includes all displayed cards.

strategy.description: AT_MARKET, PREMIUM (above market), or MOVE_FAST. Omit to use the existing store strategy. Confirmed automation uses this as store-wide strategy.

updates.description: Exact custom USD prices for owned listing IDs. Use alone; do not combine with strategy, cardType, direction or cursor. Prepares a persisted plan requiring the seller's authenticated approval in SuperCatch. Agent-asserted confirmation never authorizes prices.

listingId.description: Owned listing ID, not a catalog ID or slug.

price.description: Exact listing price in USD, with at most two decimal places.

name: supercatch_prepare_card_price_updates
